supporters.retry.description: The button that reads again what the supporters' page could not read.

supporters.list.about.defaultMessage: 支持此服务器并选择公开姓名的人，按其计划分组。
supporters.list.about.description: Under the heading of the supporters list.

supporters.list.signed_in.defaultMessage: 只有登录此服务器的人才能看到支持者名单。
supporters.list.signed_in.description: In the supporters list's place for a visitor, where the server shows it to signed-in readers; Sign in follows.

supporters.list.loading.description: In the supporters list's place while it is read.

supporters.list.failed.description: In the supporters list's place when it could not be read; Try again follows.

supporters.list.empty.defaultMessage: 还没有人选择公开姓名。
supporters.list.empty.description: In the supporters list's place while nobody is on it.

supporters.period.description: A choice of the billing period over the plans ({interval}: month or year).

supporters.period.label.description: The name of the choice of the billing period (monthly or yearly) over the plans, for assistive technology.

supporters.save.defaultMessage: {upTo, select, yes {最高可省 {percent}%} other {可省 {percent}%}}
supporters.save.description: Under Yearly in the choice of the billing period: what paying yearly saves against twelve monthly payments, in whole percent; upTo is yes where the plans save different shares and this is the most.

supporters.plans.description: The heading of the supporter plans on the supporters' page, and the name of their list.

supporters.yours.description: On the card of the plan the reader pays for, at the period chosen, in the place of its button.

supporters.per.defaultMessage: {interval, select, month {/ 月} other {/ 年}}
supporters.per.description: After a plan's price, the period it is paid for ({interval}: month or year).

supporters.price_note.month.description: Under a plan's monthly price: its yearly price ({year}, an amount such as ¥5,000).

supporters.includes.description: On the card of a plan above the lowest: it holds the perks of the plan under it ({plan}, that plan's name, the operator's).

supporters.refused.defaultMessage: {kind, select, ineligible {你的账号目前无法订阅。请刷新页面查看原因。} subscribed {你已经在支持此服务器。请刷新页面查看你的计划。} plan_unavailable {此计划目前不接受新的订阅。请选择其他计划。} closing {此服务器即将关闭，因此不接受新的订阅。} unavailable {目前无法开始订阅。请稍后重试。} state {你的订阅目前无法更改。请刷新页面查看当前状态。} payment_failed {付款失败。没有扣款，你的计划保持不变。请在设置中“支持者”下的“付款与发票”里更换银行卡，然后重试。} payment_processing {付款正在处理中。付款完成后，你的计划才会更改。} other {无法完成此操作。请重试。}}
supporters.refused.description: In the question before subscribing or changing the plan, in its text's place, when the server refused it ({kind}: why).

supporters.commerce.description: The link to the server's commerce disclosure, after what subscribing or changing the plan does, in the question before it.

supporters.failed.description: In the supporters' page's place when what it shows could not be read; Try again follows.

supporters.loading.description: In the supporters' page's place while what it shows is read.

supporters.none.defaultMessage: 此服务器不在这里接受支持。
supporters.none.description: The supporters' page of a server whose plans, tips and supporters list are all off, or of the native app, which shows no purchase, where the list is off.

supporters.plans.failed.description: In the plans' place on the supporters' page when they could not be read; Try again follows.

supporters.plans.loading.description: In the plans' place on the supporters' page while they are read.

supporters.plans.none.defaultMessage: 目前没有可订阅的计划。
supporters.plans.none.description: In the plans' place on the supporters' page while the server offers none.

supporters.subscribe.description: The button on a plan's card that asks before leaving for the payment provider's checkout of that plan, at the period chosen; the card names it by its plan for assistive technology (Choose Supporter).

supporters.switch.description: The button on a plan's card, for a reader subscribed to another plan or period, that asks before changing to it.

supporters.checkout.confirm.description: The button of the question before subscribing that leaves for the payment provider's checkout.

supporters.checkout.cancel.description: The button of the question before subscribing that closes it with nothing done.

supporters.checkout.text.defaultMessage: 你现在支付 {price}，之后每{interval, select, month {月} other {年}}支付 {price}，直到你取消。付款成功后，你的权益才会开始。你可以随时在设置的“支持者计划与打赏”中取消，权益会保留到你已付费的周期结束。
supporters.checkout.text.description: What subscribing does, in the question before the payment provider's checkout ({price}: the plan's price at the period; {interval}: month or year).

supporters.checkout.title.defaultMessage: 订阅 {plan}（{interval, select, month {按月} other {按年}}）？
supporters.checkout.title.description: The question before leaving for the payment provider's checkout ({plan}: the plan's name, the operator's; {interval}: month or year).

supporters.change.confirm.defaultMessage: {when, select, now {立即更改} other {预约更改}}
supporters.change.confirm.description: The button of the question before changing the plan ({when}: now, or at the end of the period).

supporters.change.keep.description: A button that keeps the reader's plan as it is: in the question before a change, and beside a change scheduled for the period's end, which it cancels.

supporters.change.text.defaultMessage: {when, select, now {本周期剩余时间的差价将立即收取，付款成功后计划才会更改。之后你每{interval, select, month {月} other {年}}支付 {price}。} other {现在不会收取任何费用。你会保留 {plan} 到 {date}，之后计划将更改，你每{interval, select, month {月} other {年}}支付 {price}。}}
supporters.change.text.description: What a change of the plan does, in the question before it ({when}: now or at the period's end on {date}; {plan}: the reader's plan now; {price}: the new price at {interval}).

supporters.change.price_kept.defaultMessage: 你现在支付 {kept}，这是为你保留的早期价格。更改后你将按该计划当前的价格支付，即使你之后再回到 {plan}。
supporters.change.price_kept.description: In the question before changing the plan, when the reader renews at an earlier price than the plan's price now ({kept}: what they pay; {plan}: their plan's name).

supporters.change.title.defaultMessage: {when, select, now {立即更改为 {plan}（{interval, select, month {按月} other {按年}}）？} other {在 {date} 更改为 {plan}（{interval, select, month {按月} other {按年}}）？}}
supporters.change.title.description: The question before changing the plan or the period ({when}: now, the difference charged at once, or at the end of the period, on {date}; {plan}: the new plan's name).

supporters.subscription.description: The heading of the reader's subscription in the Supporter screen, and the link to it from the plans after the sentence that says they support the server.

supporters.yours.plan.defaultMessage: 你正在通过 {plan} 支持此服务器。
supporters.yours.plan.description: Over the plans, for a reader who supports the server ({plan}: their plan's name, the operator's).

supporters.yours.lapsed.defaultMessage: 你为 {plan} 的付款失败，其权益已终止。请在你的订阅中更新付款方式。
supporters.yours.lapsed.description: Over the plans, for a reader whose subscription's payment failed and whose 7 days of grace ended ({plan}: its plan's name); the link to their subscription follows.

supporters.sign_in.description: The link to the sign-in after a sentence of the supporters' page that asks for an account; it comes back to the page.

supporters.bar.subscribe.defaultMessage: {reason, select, signed_out {订阅需要此服务器上的账号。} email_unverified {请确认你的电子邮件地址后再订阅。} not_local {只有在此服务器上有账号的人才能订阅。} restricted {你的账号受限期间无法订阅。} subscribed {你已经在支持此服务器。} other {你目前无法订阅。}}
supporters.bar.subscribe.description: Why the reader is not offered to subscribe to a plan ({reason}).

supporters.bar.tip.defaultMessage: {reason, select, signed_out {打赏需要此服务器上的账号。} email_unverified {请确认你的电子邮件地址后再打赏。} not_local {只有在此服务器上有账号的人才能打赏。} restricted {你的账号受限期间无法打赏。} other {你目前无法打赏。}}
supporters.bar.tip.description: Why the reader is not offered to tip the server ({reason}).

supporters.tip.description: The heading of the tip on the supporters' page, the screen of the tip in the settings, and the row of the settings that leads there.

supporters.tip.about.defaultMessage: 打赏是对运营 {server} 的人所提供服务的一次性感谢，不附带任何回报。
supporters.tip.about.description: What a tip is, beside the way to tip and the choice of its amount ({server}: the server's name). It is no purchase and brings nothing in return.

supporters.tip.go.description: The link of the supporters' page to the screen that pays a tip.

supporters.list.description: The heading of the supporters list on the supporters' page.

supporters.changed.defaultMessage: {when, select, now {你的计划现在是 {plan}（{interval, select, month {按月} other {按年}}）。} other {你的计划将在 {date} 更改为 {plan}（{interval, select, month {按月} other {按年}}）。}}
supporters.changed.description: Under the plans, once a change of the plan was made ({when}: now, or scheduled for {date}).

supporters.same_plan.defaultMessage: {plan}（{interval, select, month {按月} other {按年}}）已经是你的计划。
supporters.same_plan.description: Under the plans, when a change the reader asked for again was already made (its first answer did not reach them): the plan is theirs ({plan}: its name).
